mapper.select: SELECT sqa.*, s.sname as studentName, qq.question_content as questionContent, qq.question_type as questionType, qq.question_score as questionScore, qq.question_order as questionOrder, qq.correct_answer as correctAnswer FROM studentms.student_quiz_answer sqa INNER JOIN studentms.s s ON sqa.sid = s.sid LEFT JOIN studentms.quiz_question qq ON sqa.question_id = qq.question_id WHERE sqa.quiz_id = #{quizId} AND sqa.sid = #{sid} ORDER BY COALESCE(qq.question_order, sqa.answer_id) ASC;
SELECT sqa.*, s.sname as studentName FROM studentms.student_quiz_answer sqa INNER JOIN studentms.s s ON sqa.sid = s.sid WHERE sqa.question_id = #{questionId};
mapper.update:
UPDATE studentms.student_quiz_answer
student_answer = #{answer.studentAnswer},
is_correct = #{answer.isCorrect},
score = #{answer.score},
ai_score = #{answer.aiScore},
ai_analysis = #{answer.aiAnalysis},
teacher_score = #{answer.teacherScore},
teacher_comment = #{answer.teacherComment},
grading_status = #{answer.gradingStatus},
WHERE answer_id = #{answer.answerId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO studentms.student_quiz_answer (quiz_id, question_id, sid, student_answer, is_correct, score, ai_score, ai_analysis, teacher_score, teacher_comment, grading_status) VALUES (#{answer.quizId}, #{answer.questionId}, #{answer.sid}, #{answer.studentAnswer}, #{answer.isCorrect}, #{answer.score}, #{answer.aiScore}, #{answer.aiAnalysis}, #{answer.teacherScore}, #{answer.teacherComment}, #{answer.gradingStatus})

(#{a.quizId}, #{a.questionId}, #{a.sid}, #{a.studentAnswer}, #{a.isCorrect}, #{a.score}, #{a.aiScore}, #{a.aiAnalysis}, #{a.teacherScore}, #{a.teacherComment}, #{a.gradingStatus})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM studentms.student_quiz_answer WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND sid = #{sid}
